DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見当たらない自転車の写真を持ってきました。ただ、買った時の写真なので今とは少し違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不明自転車の購入時写真が現在と異なると先に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a photo of my missing bicycle. However, it was taken when I bought it, so it looks a little different now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: First explain that the purchase-time photo of the missing bicycle differs from its current appearance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分が変わっていますか。現在の状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which parts have changed? Please describe its current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真の前かごは白ですが、先月黒いかごに替えました。車体は同じ緑です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 白かご写真と先月交換黒かごを区別し車体緑同一と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The front basket in the photo is white, but I replaced it with a black basket last month. The frame is still the same green.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the white basket in the photo from the black replacement fitted last month, and explain that the frame is still green. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い写真として確認します。ほかに現在の特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will treat this as an old photo. Are there any other current identifying features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後ろの泥よけに銀色のテープがあります。写真にはまだ貼られていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真にない後泥除け銀テープを現在特徴として述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is silver tape on the rear mudguard. It had not been attached when the photo was taken.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the silver tape on the rear mudguard, absent from the photo, as a current identifying feature. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 停めた場所と、最後に見た時刻も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I also need to ask where you parked it and when you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駐輪場の東側です。昨夜八時に停めました。今朝見当たらず、管理者には確認中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 東側駐輪昨夜八時と朝不在・管理者照会中を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the east side of the bicycle parking area. I parked it at eight last night. It was missing this morning, and I am checking with the manager.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report parking on the east side at eight last night, finding it missing this morning, and the ongoing inquiry with the manager. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認中という状況も含めて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge, including that the inquiry is still ongoing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い写真だけを今の姿として出さず、黒いかごと銀テープ、最後に停めた場所と時刻を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古写真と現特徴を分け停車地点時刻と併せ示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain the black basket, silver tape, and the last parking location and time, rather than present only the old photo as its current appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that you will distinguish the old photo from its current features and provide the parking location and time together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料と現在の特徴を担当が確認します。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check the material and current features. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出書類を送った記録が必要です。家で封筒の写真を撮ったので、もう発送証明になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅封筒写真を発送証明と思ったため記録方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a record showing that I sent my submission documents. I took a photo of the envelope at home, so I thought that already counted as proof of posting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to obtain a record, explaining that you thought a photo of the envelope at home was proof of posting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その封筒はまだ差し出していませんね。写真は準備した時のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not handed in that envelope yet, have you? Was the photo taken while you were preparing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。住所を書いて机で撮りました。この封筒は今も手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所記入後机撮影で実封筒は未差出しと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I wrote the address and photographed it on my desk. I still have this envelope with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you photographed it on your desk after addressing it, and have not actually handed in the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の写真と、受付後の記録は違います。提出先が必要とする記録を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your own photo is different from a record issued after acceptance. Let us check what record the recipient requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内には差し出したことが分かる控えとあります。家で撮った写真だけを送った証拠として出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先差出し控え指定を示し自宅写真のみ送付証拠としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The instructions say to provide a receipt showing that it was posted. I will not submit only the photo taken at home as evidence that I sent it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention that the recipient requires a posting receipt, and say you will not use only your home photo as evidence of sending. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件に合う方法を確認します。書類の中身の控えも必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check which service meets those conditions. Do you also need a copy of the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中身は自分用にコピーしました。それは発送記録とは別に保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容コピー作成済みだが発送記録と別保存と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have copied the contents for myself. I will keep that separately from the posting record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have already copied the contents but will store the copy separately from the posting record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取扱いと料金を確認してから差し出せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can post it after we check the service arrangements and fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な発送記録が残る方法を選び、受付後の控えと内容コピーを別々に保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件適合発送方法と受付控え・内容控え別保管を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose a service that leaves the required posting record, and keep the receipt issued after acceptance separately from the copy of the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will use a posting service meeting the conditions and store the acceptance receipt and contents copy separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内の条件を確認して受付を進めます。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the conditions in the instructions and proceed with acceptance. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与口座を申込みたいです。会社の入力欄が必須なので、開設前の仮番号を自分で作ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座未開設で必須欄用自作仮番号の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to apply for a salary account. The company's form requires an account number, so may I make up a temporary number before the account is opened?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may invent a temporary number for a required field because your salary account has not been opened. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実在しない番号は入力しないでください。現在お持ちの口座はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not enter a number that does not exist. Do you currently have any accounts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 給与用に使えるか分かる口座はまだありません。空欄だと送信できませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用可能口座未確認で空欄送信不能と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not yet have an account that I know can be used for my salary. I could not submit the form with the field blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not confirmed an account you can use and cannot submit with the field blank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口座の申込みと、勤務先への提出方法を分けて相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us discuss the account application and how to submit information to your employer separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社へ申込み前で番号未確定と伝え、送信を待てるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社へ未申込未確定を伝え提出待機可否を照会すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell the company that I have not applied yet and the number is not confirmed, and ask whether submission can wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will tell the company you have not applied and the number is unconfirmed, and ask whether you may wait to submit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでは開設に必要な確認をご案内します。開設が今日中に終わるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, we will explain the checks needed to open an account. It may not be opened by the end of today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日開設済みと会社へ言わず、書類の確認段階も正しく伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日開設済みとせず書類確認段階を正しく報告希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to report the document-checking stage accurately, without telling the company the account has already been opened today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you wish to report the document-checking stage accurately and not claim the account was opened today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確定した情報を受け取ってから提出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please submit the information after you receive the confirmed details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 架空の番号を入れず会社へ未確定を伝えます。開設後に正式な情報を確認して提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 架空番号未使用・勤務先未確定連絡・開設後正式情報提出を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not enter a fictitious number, and will tell the company the details are unconfirmed. After the account is opened, I will verify and submit the official information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will not use a fictitious number, will notify your employer that the details are unconfirmed, and will submit official information after opening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。申込み担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the application staff. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ値札が二枚あります。この金額で二袋買えるという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重複値札二枚を二袋合計価格かと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two identical price tags. Does that mean I can buy two bags for this amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the two duplicate price tags show the total price for two bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示は一袋の価格です。同じ商品の案内が二か所に付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the price of one bag. Information for the same product is displayed in two places.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚並んでいるので二個セットだと思いました。袋はどちらも五百グラムです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同容量五百グラム二枚表示でセットと誤認したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Because the two tags are side by side, I thought it was a set of two. Both bags contain five hundred grams.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the two tags for the same five-hundred-gram size led you to mistake it for a set. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 販売単位の表示もご覧ください。何袋必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the sales-unit information. How many bags do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一袋で足ります。二袋分の値段だと思って余分に選ぶところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要量一袋で誤認から余分選択しかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One bag is enough. Thinking this was the price for two bags, I nearly picked up an extra one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you need only one bag and nearly selected extra because of the misunderstanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では一袋をお選びください。セット商品の表示とは異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please choose one bag. This differs from the labeling for a set.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一袋をかごに入れます。会計でも数量一になっているか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一袋選択し会計数量一照合を行うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put one bag in my basket. I will also check that the quantity at checkout is one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will choose one bag and check the checkout quantity is one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。価格と数量を合わせて確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You can check the price together with the quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 値札の枚数を購入数と考えず、一袋の価格として確認して買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 値札枚数と販売単位を区別し一袋価格で買うと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not treat the number of price tags as the purchase quantity. I will confirm that this is the price of one bag before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will distinguish the number of price tags from the sales unit and buy at the one-bag price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご不明な表示があればまたお声がけください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask again if any labeling is unclear. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道の分かれ目にぬれた紙札があります。「通れ」と読めそうですが、後ろが消えていて分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨で末尾不可読の臨時紙札について通行意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a wet paper sign at the fork in the path. It looks as though it says ‘pass’, but the rest has faded and I cannot tell.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the temporary paper sign means for passage, explaining that the ending is unreadable because of rain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で続きの文字を決めず、場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not decide for yourself what the remaining letters say. Tell me where it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木の案内柱の下です。雨で紙が丸まり、最後の部分が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 木案内柱下で紙湾曲と末尾不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Below the wooden signpost. The rain has curled the paper, and the final part is not visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is beneath the wooden signpost, the paper is curled, and the ending is unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に現場確認を依頼します。ほかの方へ通れると案内しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the person in charge to check the site. Have you told anyone else they can go through?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。紙を見ただけで、通行できるとは伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他利用者へ通行可の案内は未実施と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I only looked at the paper and have not told anyone that the path is passable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not advised other users that passage is allowed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できるまで、その紙を頼りに先へ進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Until it is checked, please do not proceed on the basis of that paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 剥がしたり、私が続きを書いたりせず、そのまま担当へ場所を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙剥離や推測追記せず係員へ現場を示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave it as it is and show the person in charge the location, without removing it or writing in the rest myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will show staff the site without peeling off the paper or adding a guessed ending. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確認済みの経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will show you a verified route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見えない続きを推測せず、紙の場所を知らせて別の確認済み経路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不可読文面を推測せず場所報告と確認済み別経路利用を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not guess the invisible ending. I will report the paper's location and use another verified route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will not guess the unreadable wording, will report the location, and will use another verified route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お知らせありがとうございます。担当が案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for telling us. The person in charge will check the sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の駅前写真と、今いる出口が違います。もう一度改札に入って反対へ抜ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合写真と現出口相違で改札再入場横断可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend's photo of the station frontage differs from the exit where I am now. Should I go back through the ticket gates and cross to the other side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may reenter the ticket gates to cross over because your current exit differs from the meeting-place photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先にどちらの出口か確認しましょう。友人の写真を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us check which exit it is. Please show me your friend's photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。私は広場のある方へ出ましたが、写真は細い道路側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人広場側と写真細道側の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I came out on the side with the plaza, but the photo shows the narrow-road side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your location on the plaza side and the narrow-road side in the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の出口と現在地を案内図で確認します。改札内を通ればよいとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the exit in the photo and your current location on the map. Going through the paid area is not necessarily the right route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勝手に入り直さず、駅の外から行ける道を教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無断再入場せず駅外経路案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like directions for a route outside the station, without going back in on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request directions outside the station and say you will not reenter without permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる外の経路を確認します。友人へ現在地は伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check an available outside route. Can you tell your friend where you are now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場側に出たと送ります。まだ友人のいる出口に着いたとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ広場現在地を伝え目的出口到着とは言わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will message that I came out on the plaza side. I will not say I have already reached the exit where my friend is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will tell your friend you are at the plaza and will not claim to have arrived at the intended exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。経路が確認できたら、友人にも移動予定を伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Once we confirm the route, you can also tell your friend your planned movement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 外の道を確認して向かいます。写真の場所と自分の現在地を分けて友人へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外経路確認と写真地点・本人位置別連絡を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the outside route and head there. I will distinguish the place in the photo from my current location when I tell my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will confirm the outside route and tell your friend the photo location and your own location separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内図はこちらです。お気をつけて待合わせ場所へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is the map. Please take care on your way to the meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 証明書を受け取りに来ましたが、画面には下書き保存とあります。申込みはできていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証明書受取来庁だが下書き表示で受付可否を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to collect a certificate, but the screen says ‘saved as draft’. Has my application been submitted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came to the office to collect a certificate but see a draft status, and ask whether the application has been accepted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付完了の表示や通知はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a confirmation screen or notification that acceptance is complete?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。保存したと出たので、提出できたと思って窓口へ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付通知なしで保存を提出と誤認したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It said it was saved, so I thought I had submitted it and came to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you received no acceptance notification and mistook saving for submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存と送信を分けて確認しましょう。申請の状態を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check saving and sending separately. I will ask the person in charge about the application status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ内容をもう一度送る前に、今の下書きがどうなっているか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再送前に既存下書き状態を確認希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before sending the same details again, I would like to know the status of the existing draft.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the existing draft's status before resending. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な画面だけ担当へ見せてください。ご本人の申請かも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the person in charge only the necessary screen. We will also check that this is your own application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の名前で作りました。画面を他の人へ転送せず、窓口で見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人名義で画面転送せず窓口提示すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I created it in my name. I will show the screen at the counter without forwarding it to other people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that it is in your own name and you will show the screen at the counter without forwarding it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に次の操作をご案内します。まだ発行済みとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will explain the next steps. Please do not assume it has already been issued.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 下書きと受付状態を確かめてから必要な操作をします。重複して申し込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 下書き受付区別確認後操作し重複申請を避けると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the draft and acceptance status before taking the necessary steps. I will avoid applying twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will distinguish and check draft and acceptance status before acting, and avoid duplicate applications. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。申請担当へご案内します。画面をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the application staff. Please keep the screen as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この同意書の説明をお願いしたいです。読めない部分があるので、友人に私の名前を書いてもらおうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同意書に読めない部分があり友人へ本人名の記入を頼もうとしたと説明し担当の説明を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like someone to explain this consent form. There are parts I cannot read, so I was about to ask my friend to write my name for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot read part of the consent form and were about to ask a friend to write your name, and request an explanation from the person in charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ署名はしていませんか。ご友人は、今日どのようなお手伝いで来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not signed yet? What kind of help has your friend come to provide today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。友人は文字を読む手伝いで来ました。私の代わりに治療を決めるためではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未署名で友人は読む手伝いの同行者で本人の代わりに治療を決める人ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My friend came to help me read the text, not to decide on treatment on my behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not signed and your friend is accompanying you to help read, not to decide your treatment for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのことを担当へ伝えます。署名を進める前に、分からない部分の説明を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge. Before proceeding with signing, let us have the unclear parts explained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この段落の意味が分かりません。友人が読めたと言っても、私自身が理解できるよう担当に説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明な段落を示し友人の理解だけでなく本人が理解できる説明を担当へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not understand this paragraph. Even if my friend says they can read it, I want the person in charge to explain it so that I understand it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the unclear paragraph and ask staff for an explanation that you yourself can understand, rather than relying only on your friend's understanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない段落を示してお待ちください。説明の際、ご本人から質問したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please indicate the paragraph you do not understand and wait. Is there anything you would like to ask personally during the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。説明を聞いてから質問したいです。友人が先に「分かりました」と答えても、私が同意したことにはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の質問を希望し友人の返事を本人の同意として扱わないでほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would like to ask questions after hearing the explanation. Even if my friend says ‘I understand’ first, please do not treat that as my consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask questions yourself and do not want your friend's response treated as your own consent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。署名の方法も、説明の後に担当と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that request to the person in charge. Please also confirm the signing procedure with them after the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今は書かず、私が内容を確認してから判断します。友人には読む手伝いをお願いすると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未署名のまま本人が内容確認後判断し友人には読む手伝いを頼むと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not write anything now; I will decide after checking the contents myself. I will tell my friend I am asking for help with reading.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave the form unsigned, decide after checking the contents yourself, and ask your friend to help with reading. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。未署名の書類と質問のある段落を担当へお見せください。説明のご希望を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show the person in charge the unsigned document and the paragraph you have questions about. I will pass on your request for an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の名前と写真でお金を集める投稿があります。でも私のアカウントではありません。相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人名写真を使う別アカウント金銭募集投稿を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a post collecting money using my name and photo. But it is not my account. I would like advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Seek advice about a money-raising post on another account using your name and photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で投稿したり、相手へ返信したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you posted anything yourself or replied to the other party?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。友人が見つけて、別のアカウントの画面を送ってくれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人投稿返信なしで友人から画面を受取ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Neither. A friend found it and sent me a screenshot of the other account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you neither posted nor replied, and received the screen image from a friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の送信履歴と、見つかった投稿を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check your own sending history separately from the post that was found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私のアカウント名と違う所が分かります。友人から受け取った日時も残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人アカウント名との差と画面受取日時保持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can identify how it differs from my own account name. I have also kept the date and time I received it from my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the difference from your own account name and say you retained the date and time you received the screen image. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 投稿の情報を消したり加工したりせず担当へ示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the post information to the person in charge without deleting or altering it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分が募集をしたと書かず、私の写真が使われた別アカウントとして説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人募集とせず写真流用別アカウントとして説明すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will explain that it is another account using my photo, without writing that I collected the money myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will describe another account reusing your photo, rather than say you were the one raising money. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。サービスへの申告方法も含めて相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You can also seek advice about how to report it to the service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の画面と受取日時を保管し、本人アカウントと別の投稿を区別して担当へ示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原画面日時を保存し本人履歴と他投稿を分けて示すと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the original screenshot and receipt date and time, and show the person in charge my account and the other post as separate things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will preserve the original screen image and date and time, and show your own history separately from the other post. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談担当へおつなぎします。記録をお持ちのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you to the consultation staff. Please wait with your records at hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 衣類と本を送りたいですが、前に洗剤が入っていた箱です。古い注意表示をそのままにしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗剤古箱で衣類本発送の残存注意表示扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send clothes and books, but this box previously contained detergent. Can I leave the old warning labels on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with the remaining warning labels when sending clothes and books in an old detergent box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の中身と古い表示が違いますね。箱の状態も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current contents differ from the old labels. Let us check the condition of the box too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗剤は入っていません。ただ、箱には洗剤の商品名と注意マークが残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗剤中身なしで商品名危険表示だけ残存と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is no detergent inside. But the detergent product name and warning symbol remain on the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there is no detergent inside and only the product name and hazard markings remain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が包装の取扱いを確認します。中身が洗剤だと申告しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the packaging requirements. Please do not declare the contents as detergent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実際の衣類と本を伝えます。表示を消すだけで問題ないと自分では決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実内容申告し自己消去だけで適合と決めないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will state the actual contents: clothes and books. I will not decide for myself that simply removing the labels makes it acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will declare the actual contents and will not decide that removing the labels yourself is enough to meet the requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの箱を用意できますか。清潔で破損のない物かも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you prepare another box? We will also check that it is clean and undamaged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に無地の箱があります。いったん持ち帰って、その箱に詰め直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無地別箱を用意し持帰り詰め直す意向を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a plain box at home. I would like to take this home for now and repack it into that box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can prepare a different plain box and intend to take this home and repack it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 詰め直した後も実際の内容を申告してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please declare the actual contents after repacking as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い表示を残したまま出さず、別の箱へ詰め直します。中身は衣類と本として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残存表示箱未発送で別箱詰直し衣類本申告を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not send it with the old labels still on it, and will repack it in another box. I will declare the contents as clothes and books.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will not send the box with the remaining labels, will repack into another box, and will declare clothes and books. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。詰め直せましたら改めてお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it back after repacking. Thank you for consulting us.
